article.headline: Alabama A&M opens the season with a 90-57 win over Oakwood
article.description: — Jalen Carruth had 15 points as Alabama A&M opened the season Monday with a 90-57 victory over Oakwood.
article.linkText: Alabama A&M opens the season with a 90-57 win over Oakwood
article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. -- — Jalen Carruth had 15 points as Alabama A&M opened the season Monday with a 90-57 victory over Oakwood. Carruth went 6 for 12 from the field, including 2 for 8 from 3-point range, for the Bulldogs. Sami Pissis scored 15 points while shooting 5 for 12 from the field, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and 4 for 5 from the free-throw line. Diovion Famakinde shot 3 for 7 from the field, including 0 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 8 for 11 from the line to finish with 14 points. Elijah Caine finished with 20 points, nine rebounds and two steals for the Ambassadors. Oakwood also got 14 points, four assists and two steals from Chase Jackson. Jordan Green finished with nine points. Up next Alabama A&M hosts Mississippi University for Women on Friday, and Oakwood visits Tennessee State on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
